H4701.def: a tiara, i.e. official turban (of a king or high priest)

H4705.def: petty (in size or number); adverbially, a short (time)

H4708.def: Mitspeh, the name of five places in Palestine

H4709.def: Mitspah, the name of two places in Palestine
H4709.kjv: Mitspah. (This seems rather to be only an orthographic variation of H4708 (מִצְפֶּה) when 'in pause'.)

H4710.def: a secret (place or thing, perhaps, treasure)

H4713.def: a Mitsrite, or inhabitant of Mitsrajim

H4714.def: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

H4717.def: properly, a perforatrix, i.e. a hammer (as piercing)

H4718.def: properly, a perforator, i.e. a hammer (as piercing); also (intransitively) a perforation, i.e. a quarry

H4719.derivation: from the same as H5348 (נָקֹד) in the denominative sense of herding (compare H5349 (נֹקֵד)); fold;

H4720.def: a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum
H4720.kjv: chapel, hallowed part, holy place, sanctuary.

H4722.def: Makheloth, a place in the Desert

H4723.derivation: or מִקְוֵה; (1 Kings 10:28), or מִקְוֵאlemma מִּקְוֵא extra dagesh, corrected to מִקְוֵא; (2 Chronicles 1:16), from H6960 (קָוָה);
H4723.def: something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection, i.e. (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove
H4723.kjv: abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty (of water), pool.

H4724.def: a collection, i.e. (of water) a reservoir

H4725.derivation: or מָקֹם; also (feminine) מְקוֹמָה; or מְקֹמָה; from H6965 (קוּם);
H4725.def: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
H4725.kjv: country, [idiom] home, [idiom] open, place, room, space, [idiom] whither(-soever).

H4726.def: properly, something dug, i.e. a (general) source (of water, even when naturally flowing; also of tears, blood (by euphemism, of the female pudenda); figuratively, of happiness, wisdom, progeny)

H4729.def: something to fume (incense) on i.e. a hearth place

H4730.def: something to fume (incense) in, i.e. a coal-pan

H4731.derivation: or (feminine) מַקְּלָה; from an unused root meaning apparently to germinate;
H4731.def: a shoot, i.e. stick (with leaves on, or for walking, striking, guiding, divining)

H4732.derivation: (or perhaps mik-kel-ohth') plural of (feminine) H4731 (מַקֵּל); rods;
H4732.def: Mikloth, a place in the Desert

H4733.derivation: from H7038 (קָלַט) in the sense of taking in;

H4735.def: something bought, i.e. property, but only livestock; abstractly, acquisition
H4735.kjv: cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance.

H4736.def: properly, a buying, i.e. acquisition; concretely, a piece of property (land or living); also the sum paid
H4736.kjv: (he that is) bought, possession, piece, purchase.

H4737.derivation: from H4735 (מִקְנֶה) and H3050 (יָהּ); possession of Jah;

H4740.derivation: or מַקְצֹעַ; or (feminine) מַקְצֹעָה; from H7106 (קָצַע) in the denominative sense of bending;

H4741.def: a scraper, i.e. a carving chisel

H4742.derivation: from H7106 (קָצַע) in the denominative sense of bending;

H4743.def: to melt; figuratively, to flow, dwindle, vanish
H4743.kjv: consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away.

H4744.def: something called out, i.e. a public meeting (the act, the persons, or the place); also a rehearsal

H4745.def: something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune
H4745.kjv: something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap(-peneth).

H4746.def: properly, something meeting, i.e. a frame (of timbers)

H4748.derivation: from H7185 (קָשָׁה) in the sense of knotting up round and hard;
H4748.def: something turned (rounded), i.e. a curl (of tresses)

H4749.def: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering (repousse)
H4749.kjv: beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.

H4750.def: literally a cucumbered field, i.e. a cucumber patch

H4751.def: bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly
H4751.kjv: [phrase] angry, bitter(-ly, -ness), chafed, discontented, [idiom] great, heavy.

H4752.derivation: from H4843 (מָרַר) in its original sense of distillation;

H4753.def: myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter)

H4754.def: to rebel; hence (through the idea of maltreating) to whip, i.e. lash (self with wings, as the ostrich in running)

H4755.def: Mara, a symbolic name of Naomi

H4756.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H4754 (מָרָא) in the sense of domineering;

H4758.def: a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision
H4758.kjv: [idiom] apparently, appearance(-reth), [idiom] as soon as beautiful(-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look(-eth), pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision.

H4760.derivation: apparently feminine passive causative participle of H7200 (רָאָה);
H4760.def: something conspicuous, i.e. the craw of abird (from its prominence)

H4761.def: properly, headship, i.e. (plural for collective) dominion

H4762.derivation: or מַרֵשָׁה; formed like H4761 (מַרְאָשָׁה); summit;
H4762.def: Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine

H4763.def: properly, a headpiece, i.e. (plural for adverbial) at (or as) the head-rest (or pillow)

H4766.def: properly, increasing; as noun, greatness, or (adverbially) greatly

H4768.def: a multitude; also offspring; specifically interest (on capital)

H4769.def: a reclining place, i.e. fold (for flocks)
H4769.kjv: couching place, place to lie down.

H4770.derivation: from an unused root meaning to tie up;

H4772.def: (plural for collective) a footpiece, i.e. (adverbially) at the foot, or (direct.) the foot itself

H4776.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H4775 (מָרַד);

H4784.def: to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke)
H4784.kjv: bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke(-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious).

H4785.derivation: the same as H4751 (מַר) feminine; bitter;
H4785.def: Marah, a place in the Desert

H4788.derivation: from H7300 (רוּד) in the sense of maltreatment;

H4791.def: altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft)
H4791.kjv: (far) above, dignity, haughty, height, (most, on) high (one, place), loftily, upward.

H4794.def: a race (the act), whether the manner or the progress

H4795.def: properly, rubbed; but used abstractly, a rubbing (with perfumery)

H4796.derivation: plural of H4751 (מַר) feminine; bitter springs;

H4797.derivation: from an unused root meaning to scream;
H4797.def: a cry, i.e. (of job), a revel

H4798.def: a cry, i.e. (of grief) a lamentation

H4799.def: properly, to soften by rubbing or pressure; hence (medicinally) to apply as an emollient
